items.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 어휘의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: Ms. Jones is good at thinking <u>logically</u>.
The clue helped the detective <u>celebrate</u> the mystery.
He hid the letter in his coat <u>pocket</u>.
Jane Goodall studied chimpanzees in the <u>wild</u>.
The <u>engine</u> of the old car made a loud noise.
items.explain: 단서는 수수께끼를 '해결하는(solve)' 데 도움이 된다. celebrate(기념하다)는 어색하다.

items.stem: 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어로 적절한 것은?
items.box:
• We get off at the next _____.
• Her first _____ was a room that looked like an old airplane garage.
items.explain: stop: 정류장 / 방문지 (다의어).

items.stem: 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것으로 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices:
나는 언제든지 그녀에게 연락할 수 있다.
⇒ I can contact her anytime.

그 방은 초로 장식되어 있었다.
⇒ The room was decorated with candles.

그녀는 야생에서 침팬지를 연구한 첫 번째 사람이다.
⇒ She is the first person study chimpanzees in the wild.

나는 그의 친절함에 감동받았다.
⇒ I am moved by his kindness.

무엇보다도, 저는 초콜릿 케이크를 좋아하지 않아요.
⇒ Most of all, I don't like chocolate cake.
items.explain: the first person to study ~ (to부정사의 형용사적 용법).

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.box: I'm looking _____ my dog. I lost him in this park.
items.explain: look for ~: ~을 찾다.

items.box:
G: Hi, Kevin. What are you doing?
B: Well, I'm looking for my dog. I lost him in this park.
G: I'm sorry to hear that. What does he look like?
B: He has a long body and short legs. Here's his picture.
G: Okay. ____ⓐ____
B:Boy / G:Girl

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은? (문장의 의미와 어법 모두 고려할 것)
choices: Let's to find your dog together.
items.explain: Let's + 동사원형: ~하자.

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답변할 수 <u>없는</u> 내용의 질문은?
choices: Where did Kevin lose his dog?
What does Kevin's dog look like?
What is the name of Kevin's dog?
What will the girl and Kevin do next?
items.explain: 개의 이름은 나오지 않는다.

items.box:
A: What are you ____ⓐ____ in?
B: I'm interested in space travel.
A: Oh, that sounds awesome!
B: I want to be an astronaut like Neil Armstrong.
A: I hope your dream comes true.

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.explain: be interested in ~: ~에 관심이 있다. (excited about, good at, worried about)

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
items.explain: I'm interested in space travel.

items.stem: 자연스러운 대화가 되도록 (A)~(D)를 바르게 배열한 것은?
items.box:
G: Mike, what are you listening to?
(A) G: I hope your dream comes true.
(B) B: I hope to make music like him in the future.
(C) B: I'm listening to Beethoven. I'm interested in his music.
(D) G: That sounds awesome!
items.explain: 무엇을 듣니 → Beethoven(C) → 멋지다(D) → 그처럼 음악을 만들고 싶다(B) → 꿈이 이루어지길(A).

items.box:
Junho: Minji, what are you reading?
Minji: I'm reading this book My Life with the Chimpanzees.
Junho: Are you interested in chimpanzees?
Minji: Yes, I am. This book is about the life of Jane Goodall and her love for chimpanzees.
Alex: I read the book, too. She's an animal scientist who studied chimpanzees for many years.
Minji: You're right. She's the first person to study chimpanzees in the wild. She's my role model.
Junho: Wow, that's great!
Minji: ⓐ<u>Like Jane Goodall, I'm very interested in animal behavior.</u> And I want to study animals in the wild and help them, too.
Alex: I hope your dream comes true.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용으로 볼 때 세 사람이 앞으로 함께 할 가능성이 가장 높은 활동은?
items.explain: 민지는 침팬지 책을 읽고 있고, Alex 도 같은 책을 읽었다.

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 문맥상 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: 민지는 Jane Goodall의 책을 다 읽지 못했다.
민지는 Jane Goodall처럼 동물이 어떻게 행동하는지 알고 싶어 한다.
민지는 Jane Goodall과 함께 야생을 탐험했다.
민지는 동물보다 사람의 행동에 더 관심이 있다.
items.explain: animal behavior(동물의 행동)에 관심이 있다 = 동물이 어떻게 행동하는지 알고 싶다.

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
A: Hello, may I help you?
B: I lost my umbrella in this park.
A: I'm sorry to hear that. ______________
B: It's yellow. Also, it has a flower pattern.
A: Okay. I'll call you when we find it.
items.explain: 색과 무늬로 답했으므로 생김새를 묻는 말.

items.stem: 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 적절하게 짝 지어진 것은?
items.box: Ben heard a girl ____ⓐ____ the violin on the stage. I have a friend ____ⓑ____ enjoys cooking healthy meals.
items.explain: 지각동사 heard + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사 → playing. 사람 선행사 + 주격 → who.
items.source: L5 Wrap Up 6 · Grammar Points 1 A-3

items.stem: 글을 쓴 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: Hi, my name is Ruby. I want to talk about my grandfather. He is so wise that he always has good advice. When I made some mistakes on a test, he told me to learn from the mistakes. After that, I didn't make the same mistakes. I'm guided by his wisdom. I hope to be a wise person like him. He is my role model.
choices: To complain about a difficult test
To give advice on how to study
To thank her teacher for helping her
items.explain: 할아버지를 롤 모델로 소개하는 글.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: Today was Dad's birthday. As a secret gift, Mom baked him a cake. She wrapped the cake in a box and put it on the table in the kitchen. Then she went out to buy candles at 11. When she came back home one hour later, she found that the box was _____. Someone ate the whole cake!
items.explain: 누군가 케이크를 다 먹어서 상자가 비어(empty) 있었다.

items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아 <u>어색한</u> 곳은?
items.box: Her first stop was a room that looked like an old airplane garage. ⓐ<u>Model airplanes were hanging from the ceiling.</u> ⓑ<u>A leather pilot jacket and goggles were displayed.</u> ⓒ<u>When Emily put them on, she could hear the sounds of airplane engines.</u> ⓓ<u>The room was filled with many drawings of insects and plants.</u> ⓔ<u>She looked around the room in surprise.</u>
items.explain: 비행기 격납고 같은 방 이야기에 곤충·식물 그림(두 번째 방)이 끼어들어 어색하다.

items.stem: 우리말 뜻과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열할 때 <u>네 번째</u>에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
그 방은 너무 어두워서 나는 아무것도 볼 수 없었다.
( dark, that, so, was, room, I, see, couldn't, anything, The )
items.explain: The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything. → 네 번째 단어는 so.

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: The thief was caught by her.
The story was very funny that we laughed a lot.
I know a girl who can speak Chinese well.
Nick smelled something burning in the kitchen.
The dogs that love water jumped into the pool.
items.explain: '너무 ~해서 …하다'는 so ~ that. very 는 that절을 이끌지 못한다.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 말을 모두 고른 것은?
items.explain: 목적격 보어로 동사원형을 취하는 것은 지각동사(saw, watched)와 사역동사(made). want·ask 는 목적어 + to부정사.

items.stem: 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는? (대소문자 구별하지 않음)
items.box: "I was reading a _____ novel in the living room." "I went to the kitchen to drink some water and found the box on the table." "But I couldn't see the cake inside the box." "You know, I'm trying to lose _____ these days." "When did you go to the kitchen?" "I don't know the _____ time, but I saw Tom coming out of the kitchen." Finally, Ms. Jones met Tom, the youngest son. "Yes, I went to the kitchen to take some _____ at about 11:30."
items.explain: detective novel / lose weight / exact time / take some medicine. secret 은 들어갈 곳이 없다.

items.box: Ms. Jones came with her sweet smile. "Don't worry!" "Let's find out the ⓐ<u>big eater</u>!" She asked Mom, "Who was in the house this morning?" "My children, Harry, Carol, and Tom." First, Ms. Jones spoke with Harry, the oldest son, "Someone ate your mom's cake." "What did you do this morning?" "I played soccer, and I came back home around 11." "I saw the box on the table and opened it." "There was a cake inside, but I didn't eat it." "What did you do after that?" "I just went to my room." "Hmm.... Then why do you have ____ⓑ____ around your mouth?" "Oh, I ate some chocolate cookies because I was hungry."

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: the person who ate the whole cake
the oldest son in the family
a person who bakes cakes well
a person who is very tall
items.explain: big eater(대식가) = 케이크를 통째로 먹은 사람.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 입 주변의 부스러기(crumbs) → 쿠키를 먹었다는 답.

items.box:
One day, Emily received an invitation from a museum. This museum wasn't any ordinary museum. It had rooms that celebrated great people. She was ____ⓐ____ to begin her exploration.
On the wall, there was a picture of a woman. She looked brave and strong. Her name was Kwon Ki-ok. She was the first female pilot in Korea. Emily also found an old newspaper on the desk. It read, "At that time, women couldn't enter flight schools." "However, Kwon Ki-ok didn't give up and worked hard to achieve her dream."

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 탐험을 시작하게 되어 들떠 있었다(excited).

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 당시 여성들은 쉽게 비행 학교에 들어갈 수 있었다.
items.explain: She was the first female pilot in Korea.

items.stem: (A)~(D)에 대해 바르게 설명한 사람만을 <보기>에서 <u>모두</u> 고른 것은?
items.box:
Emily learned (A)<u>that</u> Fabre wrote many books about insects. His true love for nature (B)<u>was shown</u> clearly in every corner of the room. She was so excited (C)<u>that</u> she could not wait to tell her friends about her adventure. The person (D)<u>that</u> stole the painting is Mr. Roberts.

<보기>
ⓐ 수연 : (A)의 that은 learned의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이끄는 접속사야.
ⓑ 예지 : (B)는 수동태이고, 행위자가 분명하지 않아서 「by+행위자」가 생략된 거야.
ⓒ 민수 : (C)의 that은 (A)의 that과 같은 명사절 접속사라서 생략할 수 있어.
ⓓ 지현 : (D)의 that은 앞의 The person을 꾸며 주는 주격 관계대명사이고, who로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어.
items.explain: (C)의 that 은 so ~ that 구문의 결과절을 이끄는 접속사이며 명사절이 아니다(ⓒ 틀림). 명사절 that · 수동태 · 주격 관계대명사 that 을 구별한다.
items.source: L6 본문 · L5 Express Our Thoughts · 명사절 vs 관계대명사 확장
